This is the first frame of the shot, framed as a foreground sharp, subject soft. camera at eye level. 100 mm macro lens: extreme magnification with a razor-thin focal plane and luminous backlit bokeh. depth of field around f/4, slow rack focus from the foreground element to the subject; a deliberate focal hierarchy, not blur everywhere. flickering oil lamps or torches close to the subject; warm orange key with deep falloff into darkness, gentle natural flicker; almost none. incense smoke ribbons, faint smoke. richly detailed polished bronze, ghee oil, flame. grade: photoreal cinematic CGI of an Indian epic, golden-hour backlight, sun low in frame, volumetric haze and dust, warm rim light on skin and metal, shallow depth of field, anamorphic flare, heroic scale; exposure deep crushed blacks (5th-percentile luma ~11/255), bright creamy highlights (95th ~222), mid-tones low (~82); warm amber highlights, earthy midtones, controlled deep shadows, natural skin, never uniformly orange. the image character of a modern large-format digital cinema camera: filmic highlight roll-off, wide dynamic range, natural colour separation, smooth skin tones, rich shadow detail, fine organic texture and natural 180-degree-shutter motion blur.
